name: Zeck MCP
description: This connector will allow Claude to read information stored in your Zeck companies. It authorizes using your existing Zeck user account to only be able to read information you have permission to view. After connected, it can read a user's companies, the list of Zecks in each company, and the contents of published Zecks. This allows collaboration with Claude for securely permissioned Zeck materials.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zeck MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zeck MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api-z.zeck.app/ai/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Zeck MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zeck MCP provides these MCP tools: get_company_zecks, get_current_user, get_current_user_companies, and get_published_zeck_contents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Zeck MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Zeck MCP in nonprofit on the Manufact MCP catalog include Granted, hacesfalta, Benevity, Candid, and Chariot.

_published_faq.name: Does Zeck MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zeck MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Zeck MCP is developed by Zeck. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
